components.name: KI8 1.4.0-rc1
components.role: Weight codec + LoRA runtime for image DiT quantisation (W32/A128 E5F3 scale, per-projection element grid: e4m3fn / e3m4 / e2m5 / s8).
components.notes: Original work of the four-person team. No LICENSE file yet exists in the shipped tree; the repo-root MIT LICENSE governs it. Adding a LICENSE copy into the KI8 release directory is an open item.

components.name: MI-DIT-Prism-KedaiEX1_ki8_14
components.role: Quantised MOSS-Image DiT, the actual image generator. 750 tensors, KI8 1.4 e2m5 codes.
modifications: Weight-only quantisation to KI8 1.4 (W32 group, e2m5 element grid, E5F3 block scale)
Per-projection element format chosen by W32 error minimisation (fast profile)
components.notes: Apache-2.0 applies to the whole distributed file, including the parts the four-person team produced, because it is a derivative of MOSS-Image-SFT. §4b (mark modified files) and §4c (retain NOTICE) both apply. On-disk metadata carries encoder/version/format/element but NO license field, so the license must travel with the file.

components.name: moss_image_sft_ki8_14_fused
components.role: Intermediate KI8 1.4 export of the same DiT with fused q/k/v. Kept for comparison, not used by the installer workflow.
components.notes: Not part of the shipped five. Registered so a future audit does not mistake it for a separate upstream model.

components.name: moss_converter_24576 bundle (KedaiEX1-Adapter)
components.role: 5120 -> 4096 MLP adapter that projects Qwen3.8-27B last_rmsnorm features into MOSS-Image conditioning space, plus the training and rendering scripts that produced it.

upstream_inputs.use: teacher/student features at training time; no weights redistributed in this bundle

components.notes: The adapter weights themselves are original trained parameters (14 tensors, 23,081,985 trainable). They were trained against two Apache-2.0 models but contain neither model's weights, so MIT applies to the adapter as an original work. The bundle's refs/ directory does contain tokenizer and config files copied from the upstream models — those remain Apache-2.0 and are flagged separately as `converter-refs`.

components.name: converter refs/ (tokenizer + configs)
components.role: Tokenizer and architecture config snapshots needed to reproduce the converter training run.
components.notes: SEPARATE ENTRY, deliberately. These 7 files are verbatim upstream copies and are NOT covered by this project's MIT grant even though they sit inside a MIT-labelled bundle. Apache-2.0 §4a/§4c apply: ship the license text and keep attribution. Publishing the converter bundle must call this out.

components.name: enc27b_gsq_rco_iq3s_headless.gguf
components.role: Qwen3.8-27B text encoder for MOSS-Image conditioning. GSQ-RCO IQ3_S base, re-exported headless with the tap moved to last_rmsnorm (hidden 5120).
components.license_evidence: GGUF header KV: general.license = apache-2.0; general.quantized_by = ISTA DASLab; general.base_model.0.repo_url = https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
modifications: Re-exported with the hidden-state tap at last_rmsnorm instead of the default final layer
Head removed (headless): the LM head and final norm output path are not used
components.notes: License read from the GGUF KV table itself, not inferred — tools/gguf_peek.py can reproduce this without loading 11 GiB of weights. This is the strongest evidence class in the whole registry.

components.name: flux2-vae_small.safetensors (FLUX.2 small decoder)
components.role: VAE that decodes MOSS-Image latents to RGB. Byte-identical to the Apache-2.0 FLUX.2 small decoder released by Black Forest Labs.
components.license_evidence: Byte-identical to black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-small-decoder/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors: HF tree API reports size 249,521,340 and lfs.oid d8d52ba036475f5fb07c8b435e176d3d97ebfa82f0d1a1c317f9cc1e25bd013b, which equals the local sha256 exactly. That repo's cardData.license is 'apache-2.0' and its README states 'This model is licensed under the https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.' and 'Available under the Apache 2.0 license.'
modifications: None — verbatim upstream file, byte for byte
components.notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-22. The earlier finding (FLUX non-commercial) was based on the Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Dev REPOSITORY-level license tag. That tag does not govern this file: the same bytes are published separately by Black Forest Labs as FLUX.2-small-decoder under Apache-2.0, with the Apache grant stated in the README. File-level provenance beats a repackager's repo-level tag.

components.name: flux2-vae.safetensors (full decoder, parked, do not ship)
components.role: Full-size FLUX.2 decoder. Parked outside the model path because it exists only from non-commercial upstreams. Not used by the pipeline.
components.notes: This is the file that must NOT ship. Both official sources (black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev and Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Dev) are non-commercial, and no Apache-2.0 release of the FULL decoder exists: FLUX.2-klein ships only a DiT single-file with no separate VAE, so FLUX.2-small-decoder is the only Apache-2.0 decoder BFL publishes. Moved to _noncommercial_do_not_ship/ on 2026-11-22.

components.name: Qwen-Image-2.1

components.license_evidence: HF API cardData.license = other, license_name = qwen-research; LICENSE text pulled and stored at licenses/LICENSE-QWEN-RESEARCH.txt
components.notes: Non-commercial only (§2a). The KI8 README cites Qwen-Image-2.1 benchmarks and the local box carries Qwen-Image-2.1 LoRAs. Neither the model nor its LoRAs may ship with a commercial release, and any published benchmark that implies a commercial product is a misrepresentation. NOT SHIPPED — repository does not distribute this.
